title: The four DORA metrics: deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore

videos.script: For years, people who ran software teams believed in a trade-off. You could move fast, or you could be safe. {{tradeoff}} Then somebody measured it, across thousands of organisations, every year. {{survey}} The trade-off was not there. The teams that shipped most often were also the ones that broke things least, and fixed them fastest. {{finding}} To show that, the researchers needed four numbers. Two for speed, two for stability. {{four}} How often you deploy. How long a change takes to reach production. How often a deployment fails. And how long it takes to recover. {{names}} This lesson defines each one closely enough to compute, then computes all four from the Billing team's pipeline. {{compute}} You will see the trade-off fail to appear on a team of six. And you will see what has to be decided before any of these numbers mean anything. {{decide}}
